nodes.summary: A BPZ profile is an arbitrary quadruple of integers, called its code, pairs, auxiliary and neutral coordinates: the four integer coordinates propagated by the valid-tuple product of Buys, Polak and Zuiddam. No validity condition is imposed on the quadruple.
nodes.title: BPZ profiles

nodes.summary: For every nonzero natural number $q$ and every natural number $n$, there are only finitely many cycle codes of length $n$ modulo $q$.
nodes.title: Finitely many cycle codes of each length

nodes.summary: For every natural number $q$, every positive integer $n$ and every cycle code $A$ of length $n$ modulo $q$, the rate of $A$ is at most the Shannon capacity of the $q$-cycle.
nodes.title: Code rates are at most the cycle capacity

nodes.summary: For a natural number $q$, a positive integer $n$ and a cycle code $A$ of length $n$ modulo $q$, the rate of $A$ is $|A|^{1/n}$, the $n$-th root of the number of codewords of $A$, taken in the extended nonnegative reals $[0, \infty]$.
nodes.title: Rate of a cycle code

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $q$ and $n$, a cycle code of length $n$ modulo $q$ is a finite set of words of length $n$ over $\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$ that is an independent code for the $q$-cycle.
nodes.title: Cycle codes

nodes.summary: Let $q$, $n$ and $M$ be natural numbers with $n \ge 1$. If some finite set of words of length $n$ over $\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$ is an independent code for the $q$-cycle and has exactly $M$ elements, then $M^{1/n}$ is at most the Shannon capacity of the $q$-cycle, as an inequality in $[0, \infty]$.
nodes.title: Codes give lower bounds on the cycle capacity

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set and let $\theta$ be a real number. For $k \ge 1$ let $G^{\boxtimes k}$ be the $k$-th strong power of $G$ and $\alpha(G^{\boxtimes k})$ its independence number. The graph $G$ has Shannon capacity $\theta$ when $\alpha(G^{\boxtimes k})^{1/k} \to \theta$ as $k \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Shannon capacity of a graph

nodes.summary: Let $q$ and $n$ be natural numbers. A finite set $A$ of words of length $n$ over $\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$ is an independent code for the $q$-cycle when every difference $x = a_1 - a_2$ with $a_1, a_2 \in A$ whose coordinates all lie in $\{-1, 0, 1\}$ is the zero word. For $q \ge 3$ this says exactly that $A$ is an independent set in the $n$-th strong power of the cycle graph $C_q$.
nodes.title: Independent codes for the modular cycle

nodes.summary: For $i = 1, 2$ let $p_i = (c_i, \pi_i, a_i, z_i)$ be a BPZ profile, with integer code, pairs, auxiliary and neutral coordinates. The product $p_1 \star p_2$ is the BPZ profile with code coordinate $(c_1 - \pi_1)(c_2 - \pi_2) + a_1 \pi_2 + \pi_1 a_2$, pairs coordinate $z_1 \pi_2 + \pi_1 z_2$, auxiliary coordinate $a_1 a_2$ and neutral coordinate $z_1 z_2 + (a_1 - z_1)(a_2 - z_2)$.
nodes.title: Product of BPZ profiles

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph with vertex set $V$ and let $k$ be a natural number. The $k$-th strong power $G^{\boxtimes k}$ is the simple graph whose vertices are the words $x = (x_1, \dots, x_k) \in V^k$ of length $k$, in which two words $x$ and $y$ are adjacent (confusable) when $x \neq y$ and for every $i$ either $x_i = y_i$ or $x_i$ and $y_i$ are adjacent in $G$.
nodes.title: Strong power of a graph

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
